title: Defining dependency providers
description: Learn about the different types of providers in Angular: useClass, useExisting, useValue, and useFactory.

blocks.text: A dependency provider configures an injector to associate a dependency token with a way to create or retrieve the dependency value.

items: Class providers (useClass): Instantiates a designated class when the token is requested.
Aliased class providers (useExisting): Maps one token to another existing token.
Value providers (useValue): Directly supplies a static value, such as a configuration object.
Factory providers (useFactory): Executes a factory function to compute the dependency dynamically.
